ready1_open_rewrite.title: GeoSQA Open-ended Question-1
ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: "Blowing sand to fill the sea" refers to enclosing a certain area of sea with sandbags, then using pressure pumps and pipelines to "blow" the seabed silt and seawater outside the enclosure together into the enclosure; the seawater flows out of the enclosure, and the silt deposits inside the enclosure, silting up into land. The area of land made by blowing sand at Caofeidian Port and Industrial Zone on the northwest shore of Bohai Bay reaches 310km2, with an average sea-filling depth of 4.6m. Answer the following question. <image1> According to the above GIS flowchart, using this GIS system, which item of length information about the land reclamation process on the northwest shore of Bohai Bay can be obtained?

raw_record.original_question:
“吹沙填海”是指用沙袋将一定面积的海域圈起来，再用压力泵及管线将圈外的海底泥沙和海水一起“吹”进圈内，海水流出圈外，泥沙沉积在圈内，淤积成陆。渤海湾西北岸的曹妃甸港及工业区吹沙造陆面积达310km2，平均填海深度4.6m。回答下列题。

<image1>

根据上述GIS流程图，利用此GIS系统能得到渤海湾西北岸填海造陆进程的哪一项长度信息？

Then reason: The question asks which item of "length information" can be obtained.
